{{Top|leg}}
'''Artificial gravity''' was the result of generating [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] where it did not exist naturally, usually aboard [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-going constructs. [[Space station/Legends|Space stations]] such as [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]] relied on rotating in space to generate artificial gravity.<ref name="Firestorm">{{JournalCite|15|Firestorm (short story)}}</ref>
